artifacts.summary: 4-phase (3-wave, 4.75h) closeout plan: cross-repo baseline, verify-sapience-mcp.sh check (j) with fixtures, capture-scheduling and residual-probe documentation, then five-repository redeploy and acceptance sweep.

memory_candidates.content: A research recommendation that requires mutating ANOTHER open task's description (e.g. 'append this goal item to task X before X enters planning') has no mechanical carrier in the orchestrate lifecycle: nothing re-reads a prior task's research report at the next task's dispatch, so the append silently never happens and the item is unowned once X completes. Site such an item in the task whose own plan phase will execute it, or in a records/ file the dependent task's dispatch actually reads.
